description: Implementation of the Packager class handling package management, configuration, repository synchronization, and notifications within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: PackagerImplementation
classes.description: Class managing package installation, configuration, repository sync, and notifications within the plugin.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Updates the opkg configuration based on current settings.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the package manager with parameters from the service.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for package events.

methods.name: Install
methods.description: Initiates installation of a package by name, version, and architecture.

methods.name: DoWork
methods.description: Performs package installation or repository sync based on parameters.

methods.name: BlockingInstallUntilCompletionNoLock
methods.description: Performs a blocking package install without lock.

methods.name: NotifyStateChange
methods.description: Notifies registered observers of a change in package state.

methods.name: NotifyRepoSynced
methods.description: Notifies observers that repository sync has completed.

methods.name: FreeOPKG
methods.description: Cleans up and deinitializes the opkg package manager.

methods.name: BlockingSetupLocalRepoNoLock
methods.description: Sets up local repository, optionally updating first.
